title: Ave stella matutina (Gaspar)
desc: Gaspar van Weerbeke, Ave stella matutina. 4 voices (Superius, Altus, Tenor, Bassus), each on its own staff. From the Josquin Research Project (josquin.stanford.edu, Gas0408), edited by Agnese Pavanello (Gaspar van Weerbeke: Collected Works. IV. Motets, 2010); encoded by Roland Mair-Gruber. CC BY-NC 4.0. Note values as in the edition (whole note = semibreve); coloured notes stand for the triplet groups; editorial accidentals small above the staff.
